_about: Every number the race engine uses. Tune here, not in engine.js. Section 'bench' is a copy of tools/race-bench/settings.json and must stay equal to it (race-engine/check/compare.mjs checks this): tune the bench first, then copy the numbers here. 'benchDefaults' are numbers the bench takes as defaults inside racebench.py; 'rules' are numbers written into racebench.py itself. The rest are new to the engine: the horse's racecard fields, the jockey's effort for the race view, the event list and what happens after the line.

benchDefaults._about: Numbers racebench.py uses when the settings file doesn't set them (its P.get defaults).

rules._about: Numbers written into racebench.py itself, named here. Distances in metres, speeds in m/s, times in seconds.

SPLIT._about: Groups on the straight course by field size: [up to this many runners, chance of three groups, chance of two or more]. Contiguous by draw.

pointsPerLength._about: Rating points per length at each distance (by courses/ascot-standards.json key).

horse._about: The racecard fields (agreed 4 Nov). Race-day rating = rating at its age - TRIP_STEP_POINTS per step outside its best trip + the ground. Handicaps: race-day rating = HANDICAP_BASE + (that rating - the handicap mark), as racebench.py does.

effort._about: Effort 0-3 in the timeline, from what the jockey is doing, tied to each horse's energy and speed (owner, 5 Nov: not everyone goes at 3f; in slowly run races those at the back push earlier, in fast races the tiring leaders are coaxed while the closers wait). The jockey feels how much his horse has left (the share of its top speed, over comfort, that its energy will hold to the line) and where it would finish from here if every horse kept going as it can. A horse is 'under pressure' when it is tiring (that share more than TIRED below the field's middle value, or, before the run for home, running more than OVER_HOLD faster than its energy will hold to the line), or going nowhere (more than CHASE_LENGTHS behind the leader and no better placed at the finish than now, outside the first CONTEND), or, in a race run at pace level SLOW_PACE or slower (0 slow, 1 even, 2 strong, 3 fast), more than CHASE_LENGTHS behind the leader and in the back CHASE_FROM share of the field: the leaders won't come back to it. A horse travelling well waits. Before the run for home: 0 (owner, 5 Nov: front-runners pushed along all race is too much), or 1 while working to make up ground (wanting to go more than CATCH_UP m/s faster than it is, after the first EARLY metres: after a check, or pushing across to a place), and from EARLY_FROM metres before its own run for home 1 if under pressure. In the run for home: 2 if under pressure or inside WAIT_SHARE of its run-for-home distance; otherwise 1 (still travelling, the jockey waits). 3 when the tank is below EMPTY of what it started with, or within CLOSE_LENGTHS of a rival in the last CLOSE_FROM metres. A horse more than BEATEN_LENGTHS behind the leader in the last BEATEN_FROM metres isn't given the whip (2 at most). Effort is for the race view only: it never changes the race.

events._about: The short list of race events. A lead change counts once the new leader has led for LEAD_HOLD_S seconds, from LEAD_FROM metres. Short of room: held up in the run for home for at least ROOM_MIN_LENGTHS lengths (held up again within ROOM_MERGE_S seconds counts as the same spell), listed for horses finishing in the first NOTE_PLACES, or anyone losing ROOM_BIG_LENGTHS or more. Switched: angling out or in while held up in the run for home (one per horse per SWITCH_GAP_S seconds), listed for horses finishing in the first NOTE_PLACES. Kicked: the first horse to start its run for home, and the winner's. Weakening: one of the first WEAK_PLACES that drops below its comfort speed in the run for home and loses at least WEAK_LOST places by the line.

afterLine._about: Past the winning post (only for the race view: results are settled at the line). Horses ease at PULL_UP m/s2 down to EASE_TO m/s and keep apart; the timeline runs RUN_OUT_S seconds after the last horse finishes, and at least AFTER_WINNER_S after the winner.

testField._about: Random fields like the bench's (for checking, and the race view's stand-in race cards): ratings R_LO to R_HI-1, styles in MIX shares (front, prominent, midfield, hold-up), KEEN_P keen, flexibility as bench.FLEX_MIX, each horse a 'speedier' or 'stayer' type at random, no going preference, jockeys of random skill.
